title: Giving leisure another pleasant form

captions.physics: Adapting leisure after an external change
captions.energy: Rebuilding the whole familiar leisure picture

meaning: Acknowledging change supports shared leisure when restoring the whole familiar programme makes choosing a small new pleasure difficult.
text: A familiar leisure form can end in a way impossible to repeat exactly. The Wheel of Fortune in the physical position of Svadhisthana helps act with changed circumstances. The World in energy leans towards rebuilding the complete leisure picture, including every previous part. Death in emotions allows the ending of a known format to be experienced. Another opportunity need not immediately reconstruct it. Both may need to acknowledge the loss of that particular programme before choosing something pleasant without making it an obligatory final replacement.

Suppose a familiar board game club changes premises and schedule. Your earlier evening there is unavailable, although some games remain elsewhere. **A new pleasure need not restore the old programme completely.** You can choose a brief café meeting and recall a favourite round. Earlier experience retains value even if the next format differs entirely. Reproducing every familiar detail is unnecessary before both may simply spend pleasant time beside each other.

The difficulty is seeking an exact copy and rejecting every mismatching possibility. Conditions receive finer comparison while desire to relax stays between options. Completion seems a prohibition on further joy. Flexibility helps when allowing another scale and a separate experience. Missing the earlier format need not require tonight to carry its whole fullness. Free agreement gives a beginning more life than reconstructing everything unchanged.
